capabilities.description: Move the observable arm tool to a bounded world position.

evidence_refs.specific_reference: tasks/catalog.json mw_reach_target/terminal_endpoint supplies the exact public criterion <= 0.05 m. Real instance ur5e-robotiq-2f85-mw_reach_target in assets/reach_scene.xml supplies target [-0.06, 0.6, 0.3] and its declared reset places site pinch_site at [-0.133997253179, 0.491999870696, 0.332200367321] m. Request bounds are the exact coordinate-wise reset/target envelope; nominal is the deterministic midpoint and calibrated-boundary is the package target. Duration bounds are timestep 0.002 s through instance timeout 20 s; both cases receive that same timeout so difficulty differs only by target. The midpoint is a fixed protocol formula, not empirical calibration.

capabilities.description: Move arm tool a requested distance along a world direction.
capabilities.effect: Requested displacement of body robotiq_base within the public reach tolerance.

evidence_refs.specific_reference: The same public mw_reach_target/terminal_endpoint tolerance is <= 0.05 m. Real reset-to-target vector [0.0739972531786, 0.108000129304, -0.0322003673211] has length 0.13482019531 m and normalized world direction [0.548858819027, 0.801067889393, -0.238839346339]. Cases request exactly 50% and 100% of that measured vector length; the trusted operator measures requested displacement error, not mere positive progress. The 50% point is a declared protocol choice, not empirical calibration.

capabilities.description: Set the observable gripper joint position.

evidence_refs.specific_reference: Real scene assets/reach_scene.xml declares joint left_driver_joint with exact rad range [0, 0.8], and the declared reset resolves to 0. Request bounds are narrowed to the measured nominal/boundary envelope [0.4, 0.8]. Real trusted actuator fingers_actuator was evaluated from declared reset 0 toward both exact MJCF limits: target 0: terminal 0.00293350087978, error 0.00293350087978, actual displacement 0.00293350087978, executable=False; target 0.8: terminal 0.78234022835, error 0.0176597716501, actual displacement 0.78234022835, executable=True. The farther executable limit 0.8 is boundary; nominal is its reset midpoint 0.4. Three real reset/controller/physics repeats per case produced errors [0.0007120868108537182, 0.0007120868108537182, 0.0007120868108537182] and [0.017659771650102685, 0.017659771650102685, 0.017659771650102685]. experiment/experiment3/fixed_inputs/calibration_report.json#robots/universal_robots_ur5e_robotiq_2f85/capabilities/C3 seals max error plus 64 * IEEE-754 binary64 epsilon * max(1, abs(lower), abs(upper), span) = 0.0176597716501 rad; this remains below nominal reset displacement 0.4. Selected constant controls were nominal 126.50390625 and boundary 255.
